entries.basis: Variant: CRJ100 / CRJ100ER (CF34-3A1), Wikipedia CRJ100/200 table (one combined table: values assigned to the CRJ100 by column order, which the page does not state explicitly). Range: ER 1,305 nmi, below the 1,500 nmi anchor -> 0.0 (LR 1,650 nmi would be 0.0 too). Capacity: 50 seats -> under 60 -> 0.0. Efficiency: no fuel burn figure -> null. Speed: normal cruise Mach 0.74 -> 1 + (0.74-0.70)/(0.78-0.70) = 1.5. Runway: 5,800 ft (ER) at MTOW, SL, ISA -> 5 - 300/1,500 = 4.8 -> 5.0 (LR 6,290 ft would be 4.5). Comfort remains null: three exact CRJ100 cabin reports from distinct authors on two platforms (BritAir and Belavia on Flight-Report; sumitsan on SQTalk). Comair N959CA, April 2011: operator fleet list confirms MSN 7116/CF34-3A1. Cramped seats are operator/period-specific, not a universal score. SQTalk visible publication day March 2, 2012 retained; offsetless metadata is not converted to UTC. Three CRJ200 sibling reviews remain excluded. All technical scores unchanged.
